name: Ichifuji Sushi
notes: 4 photos: 2 were printed omakase course cards (fall + summer season menus), 2 were drink-only (wine/beer/shochu list, sake bottle card) and skipped. Only fixed-price course names are legibly printed as distinct priced items; the courses' component dishes (sakizuke, otsukuri, nigiri, etc.) have no individual prices so are folded into each course's description rather than listed separately.

dishes.name: Aki Omakase Course
dishes.description: Sakizuke (3 dish seasonal appetizer), Otsukuri (chef selection assorted sashimi), Yakimono (grilled Ichifuji style fish), Nigiri (5 piece chef selection sushi) x2, Chawan mushi (steamed egg custard with vegetable), Shirumono (Ichifuji style white miso soup), Dessert (home made Japanese sweet potato ice cream)
